svg.aria-label: grpc.server() does HTTP/2 in C-core, then handles each call's events and runs handlers in Python, one event at a time under the GIL. pygrpc_native.server() does HTTP/2 and the per-call work on Rust threads outside the GIL and hands calls to Python in batches.
